name: OpenCut
summary: Free, open-source video editor for web, desktop and mobile, presented as the open-source CapCut alternative.
description: OpenCut is a free and open source video editor for web, desktop and mobile, presented as the open-source CapCut alternative. The repository is being rewritten from the ground up around a Rust core: coming are an editor API, first-class plugins, one codebase for browser/desktop/mobile, an MCP server for AI agents, headless rendering and a scripting tab in the editor. The current release (opencut-classic) runs at opencut.app and the rewrite will take over at new.opencut.app. MIT licensed.
